note: The campsite is in the Wells Tannery ATV parking area, the Sideling Hill ATV trailhead on Cove Road at the Horton Road and Dug Hill junction: a gravel lot about 40 m by 35 m with a clump of trees in the middle, shared with trailhead parking and in sight of the road. During the summer ATV season (the Friday before Memorial Day to the last full weekend of September) expect trailers, unloading and machine noise; any camper may book it. The booking page lists 12 ft of overhead clearance. The lot is about 0.6 mile along Cove Road from Tannery Road at Wells Tannery, off PA 915. Pack out trash. State forest roads are not plowed in winter. --Claude
summary: Site page re-read: SH035 still listed and bookable online, Drive-In, RV/Tent/Trailer categories, 50 ft, back-in on gravel in a shared lot. It is a campsite inside DCNR's Wells Tannery ATV parking area (Sideling Hill ATV trail): OHV staging, kept, fact in the note, owner question flagged. Fees confirmed, $6.50 reservation fee added; booking/hookups/season confirmed; pull_through false; facilities none. Imagery: gravel lot ~40 x 35 m with the pin on it. NHD: nothing within 200 m.
flags: OHV STAGING - keep-or-drop question for the owner: site text 'Located on Cove Road, Wells Tannery at the Horton Road and Dug Hill intersections and ATV parking lot. Gravel parking lot that will hold 1 camper trailer or 2 vehicles with tents. Easy access but visible from roadway. Ideal for ATV riding during the summer riding season.'; 'Driveway Shared: Y'. DCNR's Sideling Hill ATV Trail brochure lists 'Wells Tannery Parking Area GPS: 40 4 59.7 N, 78 10 10.5 W ... Go 0.2 miles to Cove Road (or Ray's Cove Rd.), and turn left. The ATV parking lot is on the left about 0.6 miles' = 40.08325,-78.16958, 7 m from the site point. So the site is a place in the ATV trailhead lot itself. Nothing restricts it to riders and the calendar sells it to anyone. Kept, fact in the note. (Site SH032 Waterflat, the next ATV lot, has a restroom per the brochure; this one does not.)

Overhead clearance 'Site Height/Overhead Clearance: 12' - above the 11-ft line, so no drop question; quoted because it is the lowest figure after CV004 in this batch. Imagery shows an open gravel lot with one clump of trees in it.
Waterfront: stays not waterfront (NHD: nothing within 200 m).
